errors.text_span: сравнява процентите на две категории отговори
errors.evidence: The prompt explicitly states to avoid comparisons unless the chart itself implies one. Starting by saying the chart 'compares' percentages is a mild interpretive framing.

The description does not mention the chart title or caption explicitly as shown in the figure (the Bulgarian question text at the top), which contextualizes what is being measured. The generation prompt asks for a brief description of what the chart represents.

errors.text_span: Категориите са подредени според размера си, като по-голямата категория е в синьо.
errors.evidence: This statement is redundant and somewhat misleading — pie chart sectors are not 'ordered by size' in the same way as bar charts. The blue segment (66.7%) appears on the right/bottom and the orange (33.3%) on the upper-left, so there is no clear descending-order arrangement that would justify this observation as a visual note about ordering.
